tagline: Voigtländer取景器相机，1939 年发布
description: Voigtländer于1939年推出的取景器相机。配备Skopar 50mm f/3.5 (4 elements in 3 groups). Uncoated.。快门速度Compur shutter (B, 1, 1/2nd, 1/5th, 1/10th, 1/25th, 1/50th, 1/100th, and 1/300th sec). No self-timer.。Manual, metric distance scale.。

specs.取景器: Simple Newtonian reverse telescope - shows image at about one half of natural size. No frame lines or parallax markings.
specs.镜头: Skopar 50mm f/3.5 (4 elements in 3 groups). Uncoated.
specs.快门: Compur shutter (B, 1, 1/2nd, 1/5th, 1/10th, 1/25th, 1/50th, 1/100th, and 1/300th sec). No self-timer.
specs.尺寸: 125 x 71 x 39mm (L x H x D) when closed.

The Vito by Voigtländer was the first camera in the Vito series, and has retrospectively become known as the Vito I - because it was followed by the Vito II and finally by the Vito IIa.
